response.query: What explicit SOP acceptance criteria and QC thresholds (probe placement accuracy, recovery %, Ussing viability, LC‑MS/MS intra/inter‑assay CV) should be preregistered for each assay?
response.answer: SOP acceptance criteria and QC thresholds include: probe placement accuracy ≤ 1%, recovery ≥ 85%, Ussing viability ≥ 70%, LC-MS/MS intra-assay CV ≤ 10%, inter-assay CV ≤ 15%.
